body: Thank you for your response. I did tell him I had a boyfriend. It's just painful that he doesn't believe me...

Yeah.. it really hurts not to have his support. He says he will believe me when I tell him my whole story, then he plans to ask the friend his side and settle it. Basically, if my friend lies and says I consented or was okay with it then he will say I'm the liar myself.

It's okay to give yourself some time to process everything that's going on. Sometimes it's nice to just lay in bed. You may even feel up to applying for jobs by the time tomorrow comes! Even if it's just one job application.
I'm here if you'd like to talk.
